findings.body: Raise: Not done. A stopped task can still show implementation details instead of a plain-words account of what it delivers. This line copies the plan row’s delivery through `plain()`, which strips markdown and paths but leaves command flags and internal labels. The REPAIRS row in `plans/FORGE-DOCTORFIX-1.md:326` would still present `--fix`, `- Fixed:` and SDK terminology to the owner. The named task test checks only markdown and path removal.
findings.title: Not done: stopped task questions still expose implementation text

findings.body: Raise: Not done. In an upgraded repo with three blocked read rounds recorded before the `blocked_rounds` field existed, `forge read` reconstructs the stop from earlier snapshots (`src/forge/story.py:710-718`). This new spec scan checks only whether the field equals `3`, and the story path makes the same check at `src/forge/nextstep.py:562`. `forge next` therefore omits the stopped spec’s question or offers another story read, even though `forge read` requires the owner’s choice. The upgrade proofs create their blocked rounds after upgrading, so they do not cover this state.
